response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced senior/staff-level engineer (15+ years) with deep expertise across JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, C++, and cloud/infrastructure work, but the role targets an entry-level Junior Java Developer. He is massively overqualified, has no significant Java-focused project history, lacks the insurance-industry consulting context, and his German is only basic rather than the required strong verbal/written proficiency.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across many stacks and paradigms
Strong track record with agile practices, TDD, CI/CD, and architecture design
Demonstrated ability to mentor, teach, and communicate technical concepts (workshops, talks)
concerns: Vastly overqualified for an entry-level junior role, likely to be unfulfilled or leave quickly
German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', not meeting the strong communication requirement
No recent or substantial Java experience; primary languages are JS/TS, DLang, C++
